title: Tiertop Bakery - Tap, drop, stack cake tiers
short: Tap to drop swinging cake tiers and stack them as tall as today's customer ordered.
desc:
A new customer visits your little bakery counter every day. A cake tier swings across the plate on a piping bag. Tap anywhere and it drops.

· Land it dead center and the tier stays full size. Land it off-center and the overhang is sliced away, so the next tier is narrower.
· Three perfect drops in a row grow a narrow tier back out.
· Miss the tier below completely and the cake tips over, ending the run.

Today's Order
Each day a different customer (Mr. Bear, Granny Bunny, Fox Kid and more) asks for a cake of a certain height and flavors. Everyone gets the same order on the same day. Fill it to earn a regular's stamp, then keep stacking for your best.

Flavor Book
The more tiers you stack over time, the more of the twelve flavors open up, from matcha and mango to black sesame and pumpkin.

· Short one-finger runs, one tap at a time
· Close the app and your half-built cake is still there
· Sound and music toggle with one button

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This game was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
